recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.unavailable: Recording not available (deleted by retention or never written).
recordings.rawHint: Terminal control sequences removed. The raw file replays with: scriptreplay <file>.timing <file>

files.title: Files
files.hint: Browse the shared drive / SFTP, click a file to download it, or drop files on the screen to upload.

authSettings.title: Authentication
authSettings.subtitle: Sign-in methods, identity providers and second factors
authSettings.linkExternalUsers: Link external identities to existing local users with the same name
authSettings.linkHint: Off (recommended): an LDAP/SSO identity can never sign in as a local account. On: same behaviour as the Java client.
authSettings.groupsHint: Groups reported by LDAP, OpenID, SAML or the proxy grant the permissions of the local user groups with the same name.

totp.title: TOTP (two-factor)
totp.hint: Asks for a 6-digit code after the password (local and LDAP users). Each user enrolls on the next sign-in; reset it in the user screen.

ldap.title: LDAP / Active Directory
ldap.hint: Users not found locally are checked against the directory and created on first sign-in. Test looks a user up with the service account (no password).

oidc.title: OpenID Connect
oidc.hint: Keycloak, Authentik, Entra ID, Google… Register the redirect URI below as a confidential client (authorization code + PKCE).

saml.title: SAML 2.0
saml.hint: ADFS, Entra ID, Keycloak… Give the SP metadata URL below to the IdP. The SP certificate/key sign requests and decrypt assertions.

header.title: HTTP header (reverse proxy)
header.hint: Trusts the user name set by an authenticating proxy, only for requests coming from APP_TRUSTED_PROXIES. Test checks this very request.

json.title: Encrypted JSON
json.hint: Compatible with guacamole-auth-json: HMAC-SHA256 signed, AES-128-CBC encrypted, with expiry; single use. Its connections live in the folder JSON/<user>. Test builds a sign-in link.

duo.title: Duo Security
duo.hint: Duo Universal Prompt after the password (and TOTP). Create a "Web SDK" application in Duo and register the redirect URI below.

authSettings.loadError: The saved authentication settings cannot be read (was APP_SECRET_KEY changed?). Sign-in with them is blocked; review and save to replace them.

recordingPolicy.title: Recording
recordingPolicy.adminSubtitle: What is recorded, for how long, and what happens when recording fails

hint.video: Screen of SSH, RDP and VNC sessions, playable in the browser.
hint.text: Commands and output of SSH sessions.
hint.keys: Captured inside the video; may include typed passwords.

recordingPolicy.connectionHint: Applies to sessions started after saving. Running sessions keep their policy.
recordingPolicy.readOnly: Only auditors and administrators can change the recording of this connection.
recordingPolicy.exceptionNotice: Recording is temporarily unavailable: this session is not recorded (authorised exception).
recordingPolicy.previewMessage: The next purge will delete {n} recordings ({bytes} MB). Continue?
recordingPolicy.unavailable: Recording unavailable: sessions that must be recorded are refused
recordingPolicy.showNotice: Tell users their session is recorded
recordingPolicy.showNoticeHint: Shown on the connecting screen and in the session menu. When off, sessions are still recorded but users are not told.
recordingPolicy.fromEnv: Defaults come from the RECORDING_* configuration until you save them here.
recordingPolicy.exceptionsHint: While recording is unavailable, an exception lets sessions start without recording (audited). Maximum 24 hours.

recordingStorage.title: Object storage
recordingStorage.hint: After a session ends, its recordings are copied to the bucket, checked by reading them back, and (optionally) removed from this server. Retention and legal holds apply to the copies too.
recordingStorage.enabledHint: Needs the job queue. Sessions never wait for uploads.
recordingStorage.keepLocalHint: Off: local files are removed one hour after a verified upload (never while under legal hold).
recordingStorage.testOk: Connected: a test object was written, read back and deleted.
recordingStorage.versioned: The bucket keeps old versions: every version is deleted when a recording expires.
recordingStorage.notVersioned: The bucket does not keep old versions.
recordingStorage.deleteRefused: Deletion was refused (object lock or retention): expired recordings will stay pending until it allows deletion.
recordingStorage.testFirst: Test access to the bucket before saving.
recordingStorage.versioningOff: Keep versioning off on this bucket: GoGuacamole cannot see or delete older versions with this provider, so recordings past their retention would stay in the bucket.
